name: AI for Plant Safety and EHS under OSHA
description: One fictional two-plant manufacturer, one hard year: a late amputation report, a 300 log that is wrong in nine places, 61 machines without lockout procedures, a camera vendor's free pilot, the HazCom 2024 deadline and a customer audit. You build and test AI for each safety job, measure it on the plant's own data, and keep a named person as the decider of record.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Manufacturing and Industrial Operations

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for Plant Safety and EHS under OSHA

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 17 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Evaluate an AI-assisted recordability triage on a held-out test set with a preset target of zero false "not recordable" calls, state what that result can and cannot show, and decide each case as the person of record
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Decide each severe-injury report under 1904.39 (whether it is reportable, when its clock started and which agency receives it, including a State Plan) and correct current- and prior-year logs before certification and submission
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Evaluate AI support for serious-injury prevention: an EEI SCL classifier's recall on high-energy, no-direct-control events measured on an untuned sample, and an AI-drafted investigation whose facts, causes and corrective actions trace to sources and rank by the hierarchy of controls
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Evaluate AI-drafted lockout procedures and AI-checked confined-space permits against 1910.147 and 1910.146, find missing stored-energy steps and unsafe step order, and design outputs that never authorize work
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Evaluate a camera-analytics or ergonomic AI system on local evidence: precision from a labeled alert sample, recall from reviewed footage, and a NIOSH Revised Lifting Equation hand check
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Write deployment conditions for camera and wearable monitoring that meet anti-retaliation (1904.35 for injury reports, OSH Act 11(c) for hazard and near-miss reports), Illinois biometric and AI-in-employment law, a union contract and evidence-retention duties
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Evaluate AI-extracted SDS data and AI-produced training for the HazCom 2024 employer updates, with zero tolerance on hazard fields, substance-or-mixture routing to the right date, and bilingual review of critical steps
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Create an audit-ready deployment package and program decision for one EHS AI use case: person of record, data boundary, evidence against preset thresholds, monitoring and a tested rollback, and a three-year cost with review time that reports hours freed as net capacity
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes
